title: 1993 NFL Action Packed Quarterback Club 24 Kt Gold Mint Collection Very Rare
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1993 Action Packed Quarterback Club 24 Kt Gold Mint Collection is a rare find for any football fan. The set includes cards featuring famous quarterbacks like Troy Aikman, Warren Moon, and Jim Harbaugh, as well as Boomer Esiason and Mark Rypien. The cards are serial numbered and come in a gold parallel/variety, making them a valuable addition to any sports trading card collection.

The card attributes include a serial number, and the card number is #2500. The season is 1993, and the era is modern (1970-now). The manufacturer is Action Packed, and the card manufacturer is Hi-Pro Marketing, Inc. The team featured is the Dallas Cowboys, and the product is a single-insert sports trading card. This item is an original and not a reprint.
